author: Dunk
description:
Greetings, fellow painters! As we march into November, December and Christmas are on the horizon, perhaps with the distant jingle of Santa’s sleigh bells. Speaking of Santa… last time, I talked a little about my colour choices for the Old World Dwarfs. I thought it might be useful to share the recipes in a “short” post for easy reference, along with my unit of Dwarf Quarrelers I finished recently.

The post How I painted my green and red Dwarf Quarrelers appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: How I painted my green and red Dwarf Quarrelers
